## Summary

Describe the problem, resulting behavior and main changes.

## Dependencies

Base branch / prerequisite PR, or None. State the merge order for stacked PRs.

## Validation

List commands actually executed and their results. Distinguish tests run on this PR from evidence obtained on a later dependent branch.

## Scope and limitations

Document unfinished behavior, external dependencies and material risks.

## Checklist

- [ ] Title follows Conventional Commits (`type(scope): description`).
- [ ] Changes are limited to the stated scope.
- [ ] Relevant checks passed; unexecuted checks are identified.
- [ ] Documentation reflects behavior and limitations.
- [ ] No credentials, runtime data or generated build artifacts are included.
